name: consistency_finish_package
invariants: G_now = Kp_now - 2 + SigmaAi; never replaced by PDF/Engine.
G_day raw = Kp_day/max/Ap approximation - 2 + SigmaAi(noon UTC); 27-day graph and peak use the same _27dComputed series.
Day_score = PDF/Engine discrete score [-3..+3]; visual overlay, not G.
3-day cards show Day_score PDF/Engine with live guard; details explicitly separate raw G_day and Day_score.
Best/worst/peak labels are computed from the same raw series they describe.
